content:
Nina: Heads-up: we're doing an image compaction + base-image slimline run Thursday. Need to confirm RBAC changes for cosign signing, audit log pipeline for attestations, and the compromise rollback steps. Reuse locks?
Omar: Reuse lock on keyring is fine but prefer creating a canary-specific key version: `signing-v2-canary`. That way we can revoke version without touching main.
Priya: Agree. Proposal: signer SA `img-signer-canary@redwood-prod` with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner` scoped to `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/signing`. No token-creator. A separate `deploy-requester` SA gets `iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` to exchange tokens for ephemeral work.
Nina: For audit logs: export cosign attestations to `gs://redwood-canary-attest` and index into BigQuery table `canary_attestations.rootfs_pivot` with 72h retention. Add label `experiment=img-compact-2026`.
Omar: Vulnerability gate: run trivy in CI. If any high CVE (CVSS>=8) present, fail canary. Also run a runtime syscall policy check via seccomp analyzer.
Priya: Add a step to verify the signer SA cannot impersonate other SAs. We should run `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy` and check bindings.
sec-robot: Reminder: scheduled node maintenance window Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Avoid canary during that slot.
sre-oncall: Noted; will be on stand-by Tue/Thu evenings.
Nina: I'll add a rollback automation: if cosign verify fails on >=2 nodes OR error rate >1% for 5m, trigger rollout revert and revoke canary key version. Also send an incident page to #incidents.
Omar: For re-signing post-rotate we need to ensure reproducible tags. Add a migration step in CI to push re-signed artifacts with appended tag `-rekeyed` and update deploy manifests.
Priya: PR checklist I'll include: IAM bindings, key versioning plan, audit export, vuln gate, rollback hooks, incident runbook, and post-canary key revocation process.
Nina: Great. scheduling war-room 20m pre canary. deploy link once scheduled.
